login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Gedara is invite-only. Enter your email and we'll send you a 6-digit code.
login.codeSent: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Check Spam the first time.

errors.notInvited: This email isn't invited to Gedara.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.badCode: That code is wrong or has expired.

notInvited.title: No household yet
notInvited.body: You're signed in as {{email}}, but this account isn't a member of any household. Ask the owner to invite this email.

placeholder.pantry: Stock, lots, expiry and the shopping list.

home.cashFlowEmpty: Your income and spending will draw here once bills are imported.
home.budgetEmpty: Set monthly budgets per category to see how fast each one is used.
home.attentionEmpty: All clear. Expiring food, bills due and warranties ending will show up here.
home.activityEmpty: Everything your household does (bills, stock, moves) will stream here in real time.
home.placesEmpty: Map your home: rooms, cupboards and boxes, each with a QR label

settings.title: Settings
settings.unitsHint: Your own units: tin, sachet, dozen
settings.categoriesHint: Grocery, dining, income… and their sub-categories
settings.devicesHint: The phone that forwards bank SMS alerts

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.themeHint: Changes the aurora light and accents. Gold always marks the main action; status colours never change.
appearance.motionHint: Aurora drift, counting numbers and page transitions.
appearance.synced: Saved to your account, so it follows you to every device.
appearance.saveFailed: Couldn't save your theme to your account: {{message}}

errors.swMismatch: SW is v{{sw}}, app is v{{app}}

places.intro: Rooms, cupboards and boxes. Each one has its own QR label.
places.emptyBody: Add the rooms of your home, then the cupboards, shelves and boxes inside them. Print a QR label for each one and scan it to see what's there.
places.loadError: Couldn't load your places. Check your connection and try again.
places.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or it belongs to another household.
places.label: Label
places.insideEmpty: Nothing inside yet. Add a shelf, drawer or box.
places.thingsSoon: Appliances, tools and documents kept here will be listed with photos (Phase 5).
places.moveScan: Scan the label of the new place
places.moveScanNotPlace: That label isn't one of your places.

fields.name: Name
fields.photoHint: Optional. Shrunk on your phone before upload.

errors.hasChildren: Move or delete the places inside it, and use up or move its stock, first.
errors.cycle: A place can't go inside itself.
errors.denied: You don't have permission to change places.
errors.generic: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.

photoErrors.unsupported: That photo format isn't supported here. Try a JPEG or PNG.
photoErrors.tooLarge: That photo is too large (over 40 MB).
photoErrors.upload: The place was saved, but the photo didn't upload.

scan.aim: Point the camera at a Gedara label. It stays open, so you can scan one label after another.
scan.recentEmpty: Scans from this session appear here.
scan.lookupFailed: Couldn't look that up. Check your connection.
scan.deepLinkHint: Check the label, or scan it again from the Scan screen.

grocy.title: Old Grocy label
grocy.body: Grocy labels aren't used in Gedara. Print a new label from the product page.

later.title: Arrives in Phase {{phase}}
later.lot: Labels for single jars and freezer bags come later.
later.asset: Asset labels arrive with Things in Phase 5.

cameraErrors.denied: Camera access is blocked. Allow the camera for this site in your browser settings, then try again.
cameraErrors.notFound: No camera found on this device. Type the code below or use the USB scanner.
cameraErrors.insecure: The camera needs a secure (https) connection.
cameraErrors.unavailable: The camera couldn't start. Close other apps using it and try again.

labels.title: Labels
labels.none: No places selected. Go to Places, tap Select, and pick the places to label.
labels.tapStart: Using a half-used sticker sheet? Tap the first free sticker.
labels.calibrationCaption: Gedara calibration · offset X {{x}} mm · Y {{y}} mm · print at 100 % (Actual size)
labels.printHint: Print at 100 % (“Actual size”, not “Fit to page”) on the Epson.
labels.calibrationHint: Print the calibration page on plain paper, hold it over a sticker sheet against the light, and nudge the offsets until the crosses sit in the middle of each sticker.
labels.niimbotHint: Download a label and print it from the NIIMBOT app on a 20 × 20 mm label, without scaling. Each one is a sharp 1-bit image at the printer's 203 dpi. Printing straight from Gedara comes with the Pi station (Phase 6b).

pantry.intro: Food and supplies: what you have, where it is, and what to use first.
pantry.emptyBody: Add the things you keep at home (rice, sugar, spices, medicines) with the unit you count them in. Then add stock when you buy it and use it from here, the Scan screen or a place. Scanning a barcode you haven't seen before creates the product for you.
pantry.loadError: Couldn't load the pantry. Check your connection and try again.
pantry.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or it belongs to another household.

form.fefoHint: Uses opened packs first, then the one due soonest.

errors.noStock: There isn't that much in stock.
errors.unitMismatch: That unit can't be converted for this product. Add a pack size on the product page.
errors.cantUndo: Can't undo: it was already undone, or the stock has been used since.
errors.unitLocked: The unit can't change once the product has stock history.
errors.duplicate: That name or barcode is already in use.
errors.reference: Something it refers to is missing.
errors.invalid: Check the values and try again.
errors.denied: You don't have permission to change the pantry.

lots.title: In stock
lots.empty: Nothing in stock. Add stock when you buy some.

codes.title: Barcodes & pack sizes
codes.noBarcodes: No barcode yet. Scan or type one to make scanning this product instant.
codes.noPacks: No pack sizes. Add one to buy or use it by the pack, e.g. 1 pack = 400 g.

product.name: Name
product.stockUnitHint: What you count it in: g for rice and spices, pcs for eggs, ml for oil.
product.unitLockedHint: The unit is fixed while there is stock.
product.hasHistory: It has stock history, so it can't be deleted. Archive it instead.

journal.title: Stock journal
journal.intro: Every change to your stock, newest first. Undo reverses one action.

place.title: Pantry here
place.empty: No stock is kept here yet.

units.title: Units
units.intro: What things are counted and bought in. The built-in units always convert (1 kg = 1000 g). Add your own for packages like a tin or sachet, or for counts like a dozen.
units.name: Name
units.hint: A unit's size can't change later, because stock is stored in it. Pack sizes for one product (1 pack = 400 g) are set on the product page.
units.inUse: This unit is in use, so it can't be deleted.

money.intro: Every rupee in, out and between your accounts.
money.emptyBody: Import the old ledger Sheet to bring in everything since May, import scanned bills, or add an expense by hand.
money.loadError: Couldn't load your money. Check the connection and try again.

form.needCategory: Choose a category for every line.
form.duplicate: This looks already saved: same type, date, time, account, payee and amount. Save it again as a separate entry?

detail.notFound: This entry doesn't exist any more.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.intro: Balances are worked out from your entries, never typed over.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.toMatchHint: move them to the right card
accounts.noHistory: No entries on this account yet.
accounts.matchHelp: The old ledger only says "card" for these. Bank SMS alerts match most of them for you (Bank alerts); move any others by hand.

balance.openingHelp: Enter the balance at the end of a day (for example from the last bank SMS). Only entries after that day change it.
balance.reconcileHelp: If the bank shows a different balance, enter it here. Gedara records the difference as a correction; your entries stay untouched.

import.title: Import
import.billHelp: Pick the .json file(s) from the Bill Scanner, or paste the JSON. Bills you've already imported are recognised and skipped.
import.adjusted: The items add up to {{lines}}; one line was added for the discount / rounding so every rupee is counted.

errors.html: That's a web page or Google Doc, not a JSON file. Download the bill as .json and try again.
errors.shape: Bill {{index}} doesn't look like a scanned bill: {{message}}
errors.type: That file type can't be imported. Choose a .json file.

import.sheetHelp: In the old ledger Google Sheet choose File → Download → Comma-separated values (.csv), then pick that file here. Importing twice is safe: rows already in Gedara are skipped.

sheetErrors.columns: This isn't the ledger Sheet. Missing columns: {{missing}}.
sheetErrors.type: That file type can't be imported. Choose the .csv file.

import.mappingHelp: The Sheet only says how each bill was paid. "card" goes to Card — to be matched until you move it to the right card.
import.reconOk: Matches the Sheet to the rupee: all {{lines}} lines are in Gedara.
import.reconBad: Doesn't match yet: {{found}} of {{expected}} lines found. Try importing again.
import.smsHelp: On the Android phone, use the SMS Backup & Restore app to back up only the bank conversations (BOC, SAMPCCTXN, PeoplesCard, Seylan Bank) as an .xml file, then pick that file here. Importing twice is safe.
import.smsPrivacy: Only bank alerts leave this device. Personal messages, OTPs and promotions are dropped here before anything is sent.

smsErrors.type: That file type can't be imported. Choose the .xml backup.
smsErrors.notBackup: This isn't an SMS Backup & Restore file.

import.smsDropped: Left out: {{others}} other conversations, {{secret}} OTPs, {{promo}} promotions, {{sent}} sent by you.
import.smsUpload: Send {{count}} bank alerts to the inbox
import.smsUpload_one: Send 1 bank alert to the inbox
import.smsDone: {{stored}} new alerts in the inbox, {{duplicate}} were already there.
import.smsFailed: Couldn't send the alerts. Check the connection and try again.

errors.invalid: That doesn't add up. Check the amounts and accounts.
errors.reference: That account or category belongs somewhere else, or is still in use.
errors.denied: Your role can view but not change money.
errors.generic: Couldn't save. Check the connection and try again.
errors.reviewed: Someone already reviewed that alert. The list has been refreshed.
errors.routed: This bill's lines feed the pantry, so they can't be changed. Delete the bill and import it again to change them.
errors.stockUsed: Some of the stock from this bill has been used since, so it can't be taken back.
errors.unitMismatch: A quantity is in a unit the product can't convert. Add its pack size and try again.

inbox.title: Bank alerts
inbox.intro: SMS alerts from your bank and cards. Nothing reaches the ledger until you confirm it here.
inbox.emptyBody: Connect the Android phone so card and bank SMS arrive here on their own, or import an SMS backup to match older card bills.
inbox.allDoneBody: Every bank alert has been matched, saved or ignored.
inbox.gap: The bank's balance doesn't follow from the last alert (expected Rs {{expected}}, bank says Rs {{reported}}). An alert may be missing, or a card hold is pending.
inbox.willMove: It moves from "to be matched" to {{name}}.
inbox.checkIt: Several look alike: check it's the right one.
inbox.checkFrom: No alert for where the money came from: check the account.
inbox.newExpense: Not in the ledger yet: save it as an expense.
inbox.newIncome: Not in the ledger yet: save it as income.
inbox.fxEstimated: Worked out from the drop in available credit; the statement may differ slightly.
inbox.nothingSameAmount: Nothing in the ledger has this amount within a week.
inbox.bankSaysAvailable: Available credit the bank said on {{when}}:

categories.title: Categories
categories.intro: The same categories as the old ledger, plus Income. Tap one to rename or archive it.
categories.name: Name

devices.title: SMS forwarding
devices.intro: An Android phone can forward bank and card SMS alerts to Gedara. Only allow-listed bank senders; OTPs are never forwarded or stored.
devices.name: Phone name
devices.ownerOnly: Only the household owner can add or remove phones.
devices.emptyBody: Add the Android phone that receives the bank SMS, then paste the settings into the SMS to URL Forwarder app.
devices.tokenOnce: The secret below is shown only now. Copy it into the app; if it's lost, remove this phone and add it again.
devices.step1: Install "SMS to URL Forwarder" from F-Droid and allow it to read SMS.
devices.step2: Add a forwarding rule: tick "Sender is a regular expression" and paste the sender pattern.
devices.step3: Paste the URL, the headers and the JSON template; paste the text filter so OTPs are never sent.
devices.step4: Save, then check this page: "last seen" updates when the first alert arrives.
devices.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
devices.rejected: Ignored a message from "{{sender}}" ({{when}}). If that is one of your banks, tell Claude the sender name.
devices.revokeConfirm: Remove {{name}}? It will stop forwarding alerts immediately.

destinyHint.stock: Becomes stock you can track, use and see the price of.
destinyHint.asset: Something you keep (a pan, shoes, a fan). You'll add details in Things from Phase 5.
destinyHint.expense: Just money: nothing to put away.

spine.needsProductHint: Pick the product, add a new one, or choose Expense only.
spine.noProducts: No product with that name yet.
spine.alsoBought: Also on your list? Tap what you bought
spine.billSummary: {{stock}} to the pantry · {{ticked}} list items ticked
spine.oneConfirm: One tap logs the expense, adds {{stock}} to the pantry and ticks {{ticked}} list items.
spine.fix: {{count}} lines need a pack size or quantity
spine.fix_one: 1 line needs a pack size or quantity
spine.unresolved: {{count}} pantry lines have no product yet: they're saved as expense only, and you can send them to the pantry later from the bill.
spine.unresolved_one: 1 pantry line has no product yet: it's saved as expense only, and you can send it to the pantry later from the bill.
spine.lockedLines: This bill's lines feed the pantry, so the amount and lines stay as they are. To change them, delete the bill (its unused stock goes with it) and import it again.
spine.sendTitle: Send this bill to the pantry
spine.sendHelp: Choose where each line goes. Pantry lines become stock bought on this bill's date, at its price.
spine.pricesEmpty: Prices appear here once you import a bill with this product.
spine.namesEmpty: When a bill line is matched to this product, its printed name is remembered here so the next bill finds it by itself.

shopping.title: Shopping list
shopping.intro: What to buy. Products running low are added for you, and a scanned bill ticks off what it bought.
shopping.addPlaceholder: Add a product or anything else…
shopping.loadError: Couldn't load the shopping list. Check your connection and try again.
shopping.emptyBody: Add things here, or set a minimum on a product: when it runs low, it appears on this list by itself.
shopping.autoHint: Added because it's below its minimum ({{min}}). It goes away by itself when there's enough again.
